updates.detailed_summary_zh: Optimism治理已批准一项提案，将此前预留给用户空投的5.469亿枚OP代币重新划入新的战略生态基金。该基金将用于支持合作伙伴关系、激励计划以及包括OP Enterprise在内的机构采用工作。 这一决定实质性地改变了OP的代币分配，标志着从空投驱动获取用户转向机构与生态增长的战略转变。它重塑了用户的预期，并可能影响OP Superchain生态中的激励结构。 Optimism表示，在先前五轮共分发2.691亿枚OP之后，目前没有进一步空投的计划。按当前价格计算，重新分配的5.469亿枚OP价值约5000万美元，接近OP约2.11亿美元市值的四分之一。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Optimism's governance has approved a proposal to repurpose 546.9 million OP tokens previously reserved for user airdrops into a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund. The fund will back partnerships, incentives, and institutional adoption including OP Enterprise. This decision materially changes OP's token distribution and signals a shift from airdrop-driven user acquisition toward institutional and enterprise growth. It reshapes user expectations and may influence incentives across the OP Superchain ecosystem. Optimism said no additional airdrops are planned after distributing 269.1 million OP across five previous rounds. At current prices, the reallocated 546.9 million OP is worth about $50 million, close to a quarter of OP's roughly $211 million market cap.
